thread:
Priya (GTM): MeterBridge sent their commercial term sheet back. Need quick eyes on metering model and support SLAs before we proceed.
Jon - MeterBridge: Thanks Priya. Key bits: hybrid pricing - per-1k tokens for generation, per-1k vectors for embeddings, plus a $250/mo platform fee for dashboard access. Committed tier discounts available at $20k/mo+.
Maya (Finance): Clarify: are tokens billed at request time or finalized at end-of-day aggregation? We need deterministic posting for ledger entries.
Jon - MeterBridge: We meter events at write-time and produce a daily reconciliation file. Charges are applied monthly on invoiced totals.
Elliot (Infra): Also need to confirm how we identify our traffic: route_id vs api_key. We can't change production keys for pilot.
Jon - MeterBridge: We'll accept both route_id and api_key mapping; please provide a mapping table.
Ashok (Procurement): On renewal: pilot must not auto-roll into annual contract. Any commitment requires explicit signed PO. Also want termination-for-convenience in first 90 days.
Jon - MeterBridge: We can add a clause: no auto-renew after pilot, and 30-day termination for pilots.
Maya (Finance): Invoice format: can you put net amount, tax/VAT broken out, and include our PO number field? Also need CSV with columns: date, sku, units, unit_price, gross_amount, tax, net, request_id, route_id.
Jon - MeterBridge: Yes we can include those fields. We can also supply a PST-shifted view for accounting alignment.
LegalBot: Please include data handling terms: data deletion on termination, limited use for billing, and indemnity cap.
Jon - MeterBridge: Standard terms include 90-day retention and anonymized usage for product improvement. We can accept deletion-on-termination for pilot accounts. Indemnity terms are negotiable.
Priya (GTM): Pricing ask: can MeterBridge do a one-time onboarding credit and a pilot discount to make the pilot easier to evaluate?
Jon - MeterBridge: For pilots we typically offer a 25% credit on first invoice up to $2,500 plus a waived platform fee for 2 months.
Maya (Finance): We'll want a clear rollback if we detect double-billing during the pilot window. Who is the escalation contact and SLA for disputes?
Jon - MeterBridge: Billing disputes: 5 business days to acknowledge, 15 business days to investigate. Escalation: sam.billing@meterbridge.com, +1-650-555-0133.
Elliot (Infra): Also confirm burst protection: if our infra test spikes requests, will you throttle or bill at peak? We need a safe testing mode.
Jon - MeterBridge: We can enable test-mode for your account where spikes are flagged but not billed until you flip the billable flag. We'll record the events in the daily file.
Ashok (Procurement): Procurement needs W-9, SOC2 report, and standard vendor onboarding forms. Send to procurement@redwood.com.
Jon - MeterBridge: Sent W-9 and SOC2 cert in DM.
InvoiceBot: File uploaded: meterbridge-term-sheet-2026-05-12.pdf by Jon at 2026-05-12T14:10:05Z.
Maya (Finance): Next steps: MeterBridge to add the pilot terms (no auto-renew, PO-required), onboarding credit line, and daily CSV schema in the SOW. Procurement/legal to review and sign. We'll schedule a validation load day and hold payment until reconciliation passes. :thumbsup:
